system.description:
A legend half-remembered across the clan, this power unleashes a city-wide storm of psychic madness — last reliably seen when a Malkavian Methuselah stood at the final battle of Carthage.

Spend eight Willpower Traits and make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of 12 Traits. The entire city — or everyone within a thirty-mile radius, in open country — falls into temporary insanity: mortals riot, loot, rape and burn; Cainites go berserk or enter hunger frenzies, draining every vessel they can seize; werewolves take their war forms and rampage; and magicians and fae revel in the sudden influx of wild power. These effects persist until the next sunrise.
